name: FinDocBench
description: FinDocBench is a benchmark for evaluating document parsing systems on financial-domain documents. It includes six financial document categories with expert-verified annotations and uses metrics such as Table of Contents edit-distance-based similarity, cross-page concatenated TEDS, and Table Cell Intersection over Union to assess performance.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for financial document parsing that is gaining attention in document AI but is not yet as widely adopted as older document understanding benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on financial documents with complex layouts and cross-page structural discontinuities; includes novel metrics like TocEDS and C-IoU.
